sources.title: [2503.15223] Are "Solved Issues" in SWE-bench Really Solved Correctly ...
sources.snippet: The most popular benchmarks for automated issue solving are SWE-bench and its human-filtered subset SWE-bench Verified. These benchmarks leverage testing to validate generated patches. However, because testing is rarely exhaustive, a patch may pass the tests but nevertheless fail to match the developers' expectations.
